verdict.rationale: Logseq documents `key:: value` page properties (e.g. `publish:: true`) and, in the DB version, tags that change a node's type (`#Page`). A hands-on DB-nightly user confirms that tagging blocks makes them typed things (project, author, quote) and helps retrieval. Simple `{{query}}` retrieval is documented, but nothing shows property value types or schemas, and the typed-tag model is evidenced only in the still-maturing DB version. Missing for 10: documentation of typed property schemas/value types, documented property- or tag-based query filtering, evidence of consistent property enforcement outside the DB nightly.
